reviews.text:
It took a year in between visits for us to decide to resurface our pool, but Mike Cunningham was patient and the utmost professional. He was courteous and kind in his interactions with us, and his team was prompt, professional, and did a beautiful job!

In less than a week, we have an even more gorgeous pool than before!

Thanks Mike!
reviews.author: Kelly Christenson

reviews.text: Professional from start to finish. Re-plastered, replaced pool and spa lights, heater, chlorinator and mastic. Added smart controls. Good communication during the many weather events during the process. The pool looks great!
reviews.author: Barry Jaecks

reviews.text: We asked Artistry Pools to resurface our 20 year old pool. They also replaced the tile, keeping the coping as it was still in great shape.  They did a wonderful job and even picked out the tile as we could not decide.  The guys that came out to do the work were courteous and worked in a timely manner.  We couldn’t be more pleased with Mike and his team.
reviews.author: HDCA Ex-Officio

reviews.text: Mike did an outstanding job renovating our pool! We wanted a handrail so that I could get into the pool by myself (I have mobility issues and do much of my physical therapy exercises in the pool). We also decided to change the tile since so many had fallen off following the deep freeze a few years ago. Mike suggested that since the pool had to be drained to replace tile, we might want to consider resurfacing. We agreed and are so glad we did! Our pool has never looked better! We are extremely pleased with the work Mike and Artistry Pool Solutions did. Mike is easy to work with and makes sure everything is done well. We highly recommend Artistry Pool Solutions for any of your pool needs.
reviews.author: Karen Arrington

reviews.text: Artistry Pool Solutions remodeled our pool and did a fantastic job. Mike Cunningham (company owner) had great design ideas and was outstanding in communicating with us throughout the process. The total remodel was completed on schedule and for what we felt was a very reasonable price. We love the new look and highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text:
We had our pool resurfaced, by (what I thought) a reputable company out of Grapevine and were having issues with formations of "stalactites" in our pool, starting after year 1.  They told me it was out of warranty and was an organic issue and refused to come look at it, so I scoured the internet for recommendations to get a second opinion.  That's when I found Artistry Pool.  Mike came out to take a look and let me know unfortunately, the only way to get rid of them would be to resurface again.  There was no way of knowing what the underlying issue was.  This was directly after snowmageddon and I told him, I just can't, it's only been a few years since re-plaster and we just had to replace all the pool equipment because of the freeze.   While here, he checked all of the recently installed equipment to make sure everything was working properly, even though he didn't do the work.  He said we could probably get a few more years out of the pool, but would just need to watch it.  When I asked what I owed him for the visit, he said nothing, we do what we can to help.  That's when I knew this was going to be my pool company for life!  Since then, Artistry Pool, has done a few small repairs and after 8 years of formations continuing to grow in the pool, we decided it was time to have it resurfaced.  I emailed Mike, he came out and gave an updated quote.  He worked with us on timing, as we had some travel plans.  Our pool pump motor had just starting making a noise, and upon initial review, Mike said the bearings were bad.  Pump would still work in that condition, so our call to replace or not.  We replaced the pump and he suggested a re-route of a pipe as we no longer used the salt cell.  Pool flows better than ever.  His crew had to spend extra time to correct the delamination from the poor job the previous company did.  Reasonable cost increase.  Our water pressure was low and it took longer to fill the pool than we thought.  He rearranged his schedule over the holiday to accommodate the pool start-up chemicals.  He is a wealth of knowledge and provided us with recommendations on general pool health and answered every single question we had.  He is competent, communicative, professional and most importantly an honest human being.
Our pool looks beautiful and we are so happy with the results.   Highly recommend Artistry Pool Solutions!
reviews.author: Amy Brown

reviews.text: Mike Cunningham and Artistry Pool Solutions did an outstanding job putting together our pool renovations.  From the stone work on coping to tile to the final plaster work, all was done in a professional and efficient manner.  Mike handled everything in a manner that assured us the work would result in a job that was beyond our expectations.  Was very pleased all work and clean up after the job.  We be going back to Mike for any future pool or equipment work or repairs.  GREAT COMPANEY!
reviews.author: MDL

reviews.text:
THESE GUYS ARE AMAZING!!
We had huge issues with our pool chemicals! It was horrendous and I could not get it back. It would turn green every week! We had a big pool party and needed it fixed asap!!
